resources.string: Your phone stops buzzing.\nNothing gets lost.
Quiet Inbox silences unwanted notifications while securely capturing everything to a private archive on your device.

Quiet Inbox requires Notification Access to filter interruptions and save messages to your local archive. Notification content is processed strictly on this device and is never transmitted over the internet.
